hero.badge: Aratau Hokohoko Pepa — Wāhi Tūāpapa Kei Te Tuwhera — Ngā Rīki Katoa He Koreutu
hero.title2: Ka Riro i a Koe te
hero.subtitle: Ka kimi a Grok. Ka pātai a Claude. Ka whakaū a Perplexity.
hero.subtitleHighlight: Ko ngā tohu whakaae anake ka ora.
hero.description: Ko ētahi atu pūnaha ka utu $99/marama mō te {strikethrough}. Ka whakataetae mātou i a {grok}, {claude}, me {perplexity} ki a rātou anō. Ka wehe rātou, ka tiakina koe. Ka whakaae rātou, {conviction}.
hero.strikethrough: kotahi te tauira e matapae ana
hero.conviction: ka neke koe me te māia.
hero.noCreditCard: Kāore he kāri nama. Kāore he here. Kāore he "whakamātau koreutu" ka huri. Puna tuwhera. Aratau hokohoko pepa. I hangaia i Aotearoa ki te $45/marama.

howItWorks.label: Me Pēhea te Mahi
howItWorks.title: E Toru ngā Hipanga ki ngā Tohu Māramatanga
howItWorks.step01Desc: Ka kite a Grok i tētahi tohu. Ka pātai a Claude. Ka tirotiro a Perplexity ki ngā raraunga ora. E toru ngā tirohanga, kotahi te kōrero.
howItWorks.step02Desc: Ka whakaae ngā tauira e toru, ka kaha te whakapono. Ka wehe rātou, ka tohu te pūnaha i te rangirua — kāore he whakapono teka.
howItWorks.step03Desc: Kawea te tohu ki ngā whakataetae ā-rā, ā-wiki, ā-marama rānei. Whakaaturia tō rautaki ki ētahi atu tāngata me ngā karetao. Urunga koreutu.
